author: naascott
text: Hey IV, so it seems that HTF flip areas hold more significance than LTF areas. If I see an area where price is 'flipping'around, I always check on the HTF to see what it is, which is often quite revealing. Also, it is good to take note of what the price is around such areas. Often times, you will see round numbers. For me, I have seared the following into my brain. 00, 80, 50, 20. eg. See m15 image below and note the last two digits on the areas where you see the horizontal lines. Both are in the 80's
